title: 2-accessibility of primes
exact_target: Does every two-coloring of the positive integers have arbitrarily long monochromatic increasing sequences whose successive gaps are prime?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 3042 (OPG-1797). CC BY 4.0.

Oscar Quester, \emph{The Primes are 2-Accessible}, arXiv:2606.00410v1 (2026), Definitions 1--2 and Theorem 2. The theorem gives an affirmative answer and proves that the accessibility degree of the primes is exactly two.
